title: Experience
text:
Clinical care
At the Interventional Pain and Recovery Clinic in Houston, I worked as a clinical medical assistant and developed an interest in working with patients experiencing addiction.
Community clinic volunteering also gave me experience with triage, collecting medical histories, and supporting treatment.

title: Experience
text:
Mental health research
My research experience includes volunteering with a suicide and depression study at the Louis Stokes Cleveland VA. My work has included patient recruitment and screening, medical record review, and informed consent support.

title: Leia George
text:
CARE · CURIOSITY · CONNECTION


I’m Leia George. My interests bring together clinical care, mental health research, and the science of how we heal.
My background spans medical physiology and biophysics, hands-on clinical support, and research with a focus on mental health. I’m particularly interested in addiction, depression, and the experiences that shape patient care.
